SessionRunnerLLM: one drain invocation
|
|-- Invocation-local boundary state
|   |-- force / continuing / step / entering / stepped / promotable
|   `-- Entry -> await plugin activation; settle stale compactions/tool calls
|-- advanceToStep boundary loop
|   |-- Location closed -> close transport; return Reloaded + continuation
|   |-- Serialized inbox inspection -> deliver eligible controls
|   |   |-- move -> close transport; publish Moved; return continuation
|   |   `-- compaction -> select context; preview history; compact manually
|   |-- No eligible work -> idle hook may admit input; otherwise Complete
|   `-- Ready context
|       |-- prepareContext -> await plugins; select; InstructionState.prepare
|       |-- Promote input: steer during continuation; queue at turn boundary
|       |   `-- Newly visible root input -> runner's title FiberMap
|       `-- SessionContext.load -> model + durable history
`-- runStep invocation: logical-step policy
    |-- Local assistantMessageID + SessionRunnerRetry helper
    |-- Recovery flags + retryAttempt + first loaded context
    `-- Attempt loop
        |-- Retry reloads context without promoting more inbox work
        |-- -> SessionCompaction: estimate, auto compact, precompute
        |   `-- Compaction can replace history and reset assistant ID
        |-- Prepared request
        |   |-- baseTranscript: history + instructions + agent/model + tools
        |   |-- -> context.request.primary: plugin shaping + transport options
        |   |-- Step limit: disable calls, retain definitions for cached prefix
        |   `-- Keep request/options/retry/executeTool, not the hook transcript
        |-- -> runner's steps.attempt(prepared, recovery callbacks)
        |   `-- executeTool waits for plugin activation before delegation
        `-- Outcome handling
            |-- Completed -> continue boundary loop or finish this turn
            |-- Retry -> wait; optionally allocate a fresh assistant ID
            |-- RecoverFull / Compacted -> bounded recovery and context reload
            `-- OutputLimit -> bounded continuation; may publish synthetic text
